discussion_comments.comment_body:
This flag doesn't bypass opt-out. It only controls whether prompt/response content is attached *after* tracing is allowed.

In `resolveAiSdkTelemetry` (`sdk/packages/llms/src/services/langfuse-telemetry.ts`), the order for the cline provider is:
1. `isTelemetryOptedOutGlobally()` (L235): if the user has opted out, it returns `TELEMETRY_DISABLED` and no span is created at all.
2. Sampling via `CLINE_TRACE_SAMPLE_PERCENT` (L239).
3. Only then is `CLINE_TRACE_RECORD_CONTENT` read (L259), which sets `recordInputs`/`recordOutputs`.

The opt-out is re-read from the global settings file on every stream, so toggling it mid-session takes effect immediately. It also fails closed: an unreadable or corrupt settings file is treated as opted out. On desktop, the telemetry toggle in Settings calls `set_telemetry_opt_out` → `setTelemetryOptOutGlobally`, which writes the same `telemetryOptOut` field this check reads.

This also matches what `cli-publish.yml` already ships (`OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER: otlp` + `CLINE_TRACE_RECORD_CONTENT: "true"`). Desktop was just missing it.
